statement: 100% original, generated from code by FEL (fel_synth + flip_* modules). No samples, no third-party audio, no recognisable melodies. Spoken chops are Kokoro-82M synthetic voices rendered locally; no real person.

finder.note: onsets = Flip.ts onsetSlices on the decoded file at 44.1 kHz (identical at 48 kHz)

decoding.note: a decoder that returns more than `samples` added LAME priming at the START: trim encoderDelay + 529 samples there, then cut to `samples`

items.title: Sunday Tape
items.character: Soulful Eb: warm electric-piano chords, a two-horn section answering, late-night and hopeful.

lesson.tip: Pads 1 to 16 in order play the theme. Flip it: 1, 12 and 8 on a 3-3-2, then let the horns on 4 and 5 answer.

items.title: Skyline Anthem
items.character: Bright D-major synth-brass anthem: stacked brass stabs under a heroic lead that climbs to bar 4.

lesson.tip: Pads 1 to 15 in order play the anthem. Flip it: 1, jump to the peak on 13, fall through 12 and 8, then land on 15.

items.title: Dust & Strings
items.character: Dusty A-minor flute over plucked strings: cinematic, a little wistful, like an old film reel.

lesson.tip: Pads 1 to 16 in order play the theme. Flip it: 1, 6, 11, the pizz on 8, then 16 leads you back to 1.

provenance.process: band-pass 400 Hz-3.2 kHz (+3 dB at 1.5 kHz), drive 0.3, slap echo 92 ms -9 dB
three hits on 16ths at 100 BPM, first two gated to 70 % (105 ms)
varispeed +5 st, then the base light processing

tuning.stretch: TD-PSOLA to 1.0 s at C5 (formants kept), levelled, vibrato 5.2 Hz +-18 cents after 0.3 s, plate 0.14
